notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-1.100.0.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - MCP server chay thang trong Revit, KHONG can cai Node.js: moi may cai bo addin deu noi duoc voi Claude. - Claude Code: claude mcp add --scope user --transport http hpcons-revit http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp (hoac bam nut "Cau hinh Claude" > "Cau hinh Claude Code"). - Claude Desktop: nut "Cau hinh Claude" > "Cau hinh Claude Desktop" (them server qua HpconsMcpBridge.exe), dong han Claude Desktop roi mo lai.
